text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother... I... I...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister... I... I...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah... So close!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I kept thinking, "just a little more and I'll
catch up
to her!" but I just couldn't do it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I wanted to catch her so badly this time!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Gyah! Bourbon?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I was surprised by your performance
today.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I could not help but wonder how you are
able to
run like that...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Finally, I arrived at a single conclusion...
One you
speak of often.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It was all to "catch up" to me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Speaking honestly, I still do not
understand it. In
a race, there is only
victory or defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: There is no "catching up." Yet...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Can you hear that?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
What a race! Good job, Bourbon! Good
job, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
As expected of this year's stars! I'm so
excited to
see them again next year!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-they're not just cheering for you...
They're
cheering for me too?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but... compared to you... I'm just...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, I concur with the crowd. You and I
are equals
in ability.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: So I will say this...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will not lose to you next time either...
My rival.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ri...val...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice. Will you race against me again?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I won't lose either! Next time... I'll win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower's voice echoes loudly. Her
daring
declaration reaches the ears of
not only those
nearby, but everyone at
the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think about what race she should run in
next to
help her talent as a stayer bloom
even further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, we'll prepare for the Nikkei Sho as
a
jumping-off point.
